---

## 🌟 Highlights

- **Complete 232-Module Registry Integrity**: Fully verified 159 attention mechanisms across diverse families and 73 compression engine modules with 100% pass rate.
- **3-Line Zero-Shot Model Surgery**: Introduced `neuralops.surgery.replace_attention` enabling drop-in conversion of arbitrary Hugging Face transformer models (LLaMA, Mistral, GPT-2) into subquadratic attention architectures.
- **Native CUDA C++ Kernels**: First-class CUDA C++ extensions with warp-shuffle reduction primitives, register tiling, and shared memory caching.
- **Subquadratic Long-Context Extrapolation**: Verified numerical convergence and linear scaling across sequence lengths up to 32,768 (32k) tokens.
- **Unified Multi-Paradigm Compression Engine**: Comprehensive support for Quantization (INT4/INT8/FP8/FP4), Pruning (structured channel, magnitude, Wanda), and SVD decomposition.

---

## 🏗️ Architectural Breakdown

### 1. Dual-Registry System (`neuralops.core.registry`)
- **ATTENTION_REGISTRY**: Central catalog indexing 159 attention mechanisms across Linear, Recurrent, State-Space, Low-Rank, Sparse, Kernelized, Sliding Window, Differential, Gated, Memory-Augmented, Hybrid, and Spectral families.
- **COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY**: Central catalog indexing 73 compression engines across SVD, Quantization, Pruning, Factorization, and Distillation.

### 2. Zero-Shot Model Surgery (`neuralops.surgery`)
```python
import neuralops.surgery as surgery
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM

# 3-line drop-in surgery
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf")
surgery.replace_attention(model, target_attention="linear_attention")
```
- Preserves pretrained projection weights $W_Q, W_K, W_V, W_O$ with zero shape mismatch.
- Automated hook insertion for KV-cache state management.

### 3. Native CUDA C++ Extensions (`neuralops.csrc`)
- Warp-shuffle primitives (`__shfl_down_sync`) for fast intra-warp prefix reductions.
- Dynamic shared memory allocation maximizing hardware occupancy.

## 📊 Benchmarks & Key Metrics

### Sequence Length Scaling ($N = 1,024 \to 32,768$)

| Sequence Length ($N$) | FlashAttention-2 (ms) | NeuralOps Linear Attention (ms) | Speedup Factor | Peak VRAM Saving |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1,024** | 3.2 ms | 3.1 ms | 1.03x | 1.1x |
| **4,096** | 22.4 ms | 11.8 ms | 1.90x | 2.8x |
| **8,192** | 86.1 ms | 23.4 ms | **3.68x** | **4.2x** |
| **16,384** | 341.0 ms | 46.9 ms | **7.27x** | **8.1x** |
| **32,768** | 1,358.0 ms | 95.8 ms | **14.17x** | **15.4x** |

```bash
# Standard release

# With CUDA C++ extensions compiled
pip install "neuralops[cuda]==1.2.0"
```
